competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (medicinal-plants strand): itinutugma ng BHW ang bawat isa sa sampung halaman sa botanical name, nakalistang bahagi at nakalistang gamit sa kasalukuyang reference card, sinasabi kung ano pa ang kailangang kumpirmahin, at iniuugnay ang tanong ng residente sa clinician — nang hindi naghahanda, nagtatakda ng dose o nagpapalit ng niresetang gamot.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (medicinal-plants strand): the BHW matches each of the ten plants to its botanical name, listed part and listed use on a current reference card, states what still needs confirmation, and connects the resident's question to a clinician — without preparing a remedy, setting a dose or replacing prescribed treatment.
